_comment: Shared Next-app TypeScript preset (SMA-502). It extends the workspace base by relative path: pnpm symlinks this package into node_modules, and `extends` resolves through the symlink's real path, so ../../tsconfig.base.json lands on ts/tsconfig.base.json. An app extends '@paigasus/next-config/tsconfig-app' and adds only what is app-specific.
_comment_vitest: An app that adopts this preset AND runs vitest also needs its own tests/tsconfig.json, extending ts/tsconfig.base.json by relative path (the pattern every other package already uses). Reason: `tsc` resolves the extends chain above by following the pnpm symlink to its real path first, but vitest's oxc-based resolver does not — it applies the ../../ in THIS file relative to the symlink's own node_modules location and fails hard with '[TSCONFIG_ERROR] Failed to load tsconfig … Tsconfig not found'. Grep that text if you land here from a stack trace. The fix is a duplicated one-line-extends file, not inlining this preset's compilerOptions into every app: inlining would duplicate roughly fourteen options across files that must agree, with nothing gating that agreement, which is an ungated drift surface this repo treats as a serious failure mode. A per-app file plus a loud, documented failure beats a silent one.
